steps.name: build-install-and-start-shizuku
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1
git checkout -B work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1 origin/work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0bca996803c3b00930c95d7d041112d60eb1cbf2"
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'
adb start-server >/dev/null
adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = 'SM-S906B'
test "$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'
adb -s "$SEL" install --no-streaming -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
for P in android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; do
  adb -s "$SEL" shell pm grant "$PKG" "$P"
done
BASE="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell pm path moe.shizuku.privileged.api | head -1 | sed 's/^package://' | tr -d '\r')"
test -n "$BASE"
ROOT="$(dirname "$BASE")"
STARTER="$ROOT/lib/arm64/libshizuku.so"
if ! adb -s "$SEL" shell test -x "$STARTER"; then
  STARTER="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell find "$ROOT" -type f -name libshizuku.so 2>/dev/null | head -1 | tr -d '\r')"
fi
test -n "$STARTER"
adb -s "$SEL" shell "$STARTER"
sleep 4
adb -s "$SEL" shell ps -A | grep shizuku_server
echo 'shizuku_server_running=true'
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.calls.live_call_readiness --serial "$SEL"

steps.name: arm-launch-and-observe-real-call
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'
adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f shared_prefs/debug_auto_clir_bootstrap.xml shared_prefs/campaign_runtime_status_v1.xml
adb -s "$SEL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"
adb -s "$SEL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, subprocess, time, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
SEL="192.168.0.100:46769"
PKG="pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge"

def run(args, timeout=8):
    p=subprocess.run(args,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=timeout,check=False)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.replace("\r","")

def call_state():
    _,out=run(["adb","-s",SEL,"shell","dumpsys","telephony.registry"],10)
    vals=re.findall(r"mCallState=(\d+)",out)
    return int(vals[0]) if vals else None

def status():
    code,out=run(["adb","-s",SEL,"shell","run-as",PKG,"cat","shared_prefs/campaign_runtime_status_v1.xml"],5)
    if code!=0 or not out.strip():
        return None
    try:
        root=ET.fromstring(out)
        for node in root:
            if node.attrib.get("name")=="status":
                return (node.text or "").strip()
    except Exception:
        return None
    return None

seen=[]
last_status=None
active_seen=False
deadline=time.time()+300
while time.time()<deadline:
    st=call_state()
    if st is not None and (not seen or seen[-1]!=st):
        seen.append(st)
        print(f"call_state_transition={st}",flush=True)
    if st in (1,2):
        active_seen=True
    cur=status()
    if cur and cur!=last_status:
        last_status=cur
        print("campaign_status="+cur.replace("\n"," ").replace("\r"," ")[:500],flush=True)
    if active_seen and st==0 and cur and (
        "cleanup=" in cur.lower() or
        "success" in cur.lower() or
        "failed" in cur.lower() or
        "without accepted success" in cur.lower()
    ):
        break
    time.sleep(2)

print("active_call_observed="+str(active_seen).lower())
print("call_state_sequence="+",".join(map(str,seen)))
print("final_campaign_status="+((last_status or "missing").replace("\n"," ").replace("\r"," ")[:500]))
if not active_seen:
    raise SystemExit("real_call_was_not_observed")
PY
